The sculpted case and custom sapphire crystal deliver the same distinctive character as the rest of the collection, while the vertically brushed black dial brings a more refined expression. Rich textures, crisp white Roman numerals, and subtle depth create a dial that reveals more with every glance. Understated. Elegant. Effortlessly versatile.
